questions.question: Walk me through your process for completing month-end close, including manual journal entries, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
In your Accountant II role at Ellwood Group, how did you prepare and maintain fixed-asset roll-forward schedules and reconcile them to the general ledger?
Describe a balance sheet reconciliation where you identified a significant reconciling item. How did you investigate it, resolve it, and communicate the issue to management?
What is your experience preparing monthly accrual schedules, and how do you determine whether an expense should be accrued at month-end?

This role includes lease accounting and maintaining lease schedules. Your Bloomberg experience included reviewing leases and contractual obligations in financial statements; how would you approach building or maintaining a lease-accounting schedule under US GAAP?
Describe the monthly, quarterly, or annual reporting packages you prepared at George Washington University. What financial statements, supporting schedules, and review procedures were involved?
How have you performed variance or flux analysis between actual results, budget, and prior periods? Please provide an example of an insight you identified and how it was used.

When reviewing invoices at Ellwood Group, how did you determine whether an item should be capitalized as a fixed asset or expensed? What documentation and accounting policy considerations did you use?
What Excel tools or techniques do you regularly use to prepare reconciliations, reporting schedules, and financial analyses?
Give an example of how you partnered with Accounts Payable, Purchasing, or another operational department to resolve an accounting issue or improve the accuracy of financial reporting.
